sourceOnlyPairRule: Same component; opposite sides have source horizontal gap90..110. Both image left/right assignments and inner/outer combinations retained.
syntheticPurpose: Consistent synthetic projections verify local model observability only, not a historical pose or source-label likelihood. limits: Actual image lines are approximate retrospective measurements, not uniquely identified source edges.
Tank descriptor point has4 source alternatives and retains fit role; no heldout point is invented.
No source label is ranked, selected or rejected by historical image residual.
Ideal parallel infinite vertical lines plus one point do not supply a unique camera when horizontal stretch is free.
Tiny nonparallel decoded endpoints can technically supply additional weak numerical rank; exact-source spectra and threshold sensitivity are reported rather than hidden.
Source FOV50 and centered principal point remain explicit; optional camera bank is diagnostic.
A fit to noisy incompatible lines can show spurious extra numerical rank; structural and consistent synthetic rank are the relevant bounds.
Rank is local; full global ambiguity and conditioning may be worse.
A new independent finite-endpoint or other line-family constraint requires semantic proof, not photographed texture edges.
V12/V14 remain open; no native lighting claim.
